slices.done_when: Running `bun install` in the PR checkout leaves bun.lock and node_modules agreeing on the current published host release (`@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent`, `@oh-my-pi/pi-tui` and `@oh-my-pi/omptype` at the same 18.20.x), `node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/src/html-form/parse.ts` and `node_modules/@oh-my-pi/omptype/src/zod.ts` both exist, and `bun run check && bun test` still exit 0 with the command unchanged (verified in a throwaway copy at 18.20.2: `tsc --noEmit` exit 0, test/extension.test.ts 98 pass 0 fail).
